environment.description: Django REST API deployed on ECS Fargate in us-east-1. The ECS task role (arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/notification-svc-task-role) has SecretsManager read access and no permission boundary attached. Django settings have ALLOWED_HOSTS=['*'], DEBUG=False. The service is exposed via internal ALB with no WAF. Django template engine is configured with default settings (no sandboxing). The task role also has ssm:GetParameter and sts:AssumeRole permissions for cross-account access.

config.network: internal ALB, no restrictions on template content
